about: Starting stats per class for the Build planner: the front number of the status window is base + floor(per level x (stat level - 1)), per level from data/builds.json stats.perAttrLevel. A stat's level is floor((4 + growth x (level - 1)) / 4) plus the bonus points put in it. Worked out from in-game status windows; a class without numbers here asks the player to type their window once.

Cat.checked: 2026-11-21 in game: Primadonna growth 4-1-1-4 at Lv.146, 152 and 160 (every stat matches)
